title: introduce-cost-optimizer-suggester-cli-and-recommendation-dryrun
author: Marta Alvarez
release_notes: Add cost-suggester CLI with safe dry-run preview mode, telemetry for recommendation previews, new presets YAML and docs. Backwards-compatible; gated behind feature flag.
description:
Summary: Introduces a new command-line tool 'redwood cost-suggester' and a safe 'recommendation dry-run' flow for tenant cost optimization (batching/caching defaults, suggested quant profiles, and unit-econ impact estimates). Motivation: teams repeatedly ask for a low-friction way to get deterministic, tenant-scoped cost suggestions without applying changes. This PR delivers a preview-first UX, a small presets format, and instrumentation so product can measure suggestion uptake and accuracy.

What this PR does (single-string description): Adds CLI subcommands: 'redwood cost-suggester preview --tenant-id <id> [--simulate] [--output preview.yaml]' and 'redwood cost-suggester apply --tenant-id <id> --preset <name>' (apply gated behind feature flag). By default preview is a dry-run and emits telemetry event cost.suggester.recommendation.preview containing suggestion fingerprint and unit-econ delta. The CLI consults historical telemetry (sampled token/latency distributions) and runs an internal unit-econ estimator to produce ranked suggestions (batch size, prefix-cache hint, quant profile). Suggestions include a conservative safety score and a migration path.

Checklist: [x] CLI and library implementation; [x] unit tests for estimator and safety scoring; [x] integration test for dry-run end-to-end; [x] telemetry events + schema; [x] docs page and quickstart; [x] feature-flag gating and server-side opt-in settings.

Commits (high level): 1) init: add CLI scaffolding and command docs; 2) impl: unit-econ estimator and suggester core + presets parser; 3) telemetry: add preview event and schema; 4) tests: unit + integration dry-run; 5) docs: ops + examples; 6) fix: handle missing tenant history fallback.

Changed files (high level): cmd/cost-suggester/main.go (new CLI wiring), internal/econ/suggester.go (core algorithm), internal/econ/estimator_test.go (unit tests), pkg/telemetry/events.go (new event), deploy/presets/cost-presets-v1.yaml (new starter presets), docs/ops/cost-suggester.md (operator docs), tests/integration/cost_suggester_dryrun_test.go (integration), internal/config/flags.go (feature flag config). Small illustrative snippet (CLI help): "$ redwood cost-suggester preview --tenant-id t-12345 --output preview.yaml" -> generates a preview YAML with fields: suggested_batch, suggested_cache_policy, quant_profile, estimated_monthly_savings_usd, safety_score.

Implementation notes: - Estimator uses sampled per-tenant latency/token histograms (10% sample) and a small econometric model trained on synthetic microbenchmarks; defaults back to global profile if tenant history is sparse. - Suggestions are conservative by default (safety_score >= 0.6) and include a fallback route that keeps original model/route in place for canarying. - Telemetry is GDPR-friendly: previews emit only fingerprints/hashes for suggestions and aggregated numeric deltas; no raw prompts or user content. - Feature flag: redwood.cost.suggester.enable (default false for new clusters; enabled for pilot tenants).

Review conversation summary (single-string): Ethan: "Nice separation between CLI and estimator; please add more tests around sparse-tenant fallback and edge-case histograms." Marta: "Added sparse-tenant unit test and amended estimator to clamp quant suggestions when latency skew > 3x." Priya: "Telemetry schema LGTM, confirm events are sampled at 1% by default." Marta: "Yes, sampling handled by pkg/telemetry with config default 0.01; added note in docs." Jordan: "Docs need an example of reading preview.yaml and running a 'safe apply' CI job." Marta: "Added a short CI snippet in docs/ops/cost-suggester.md showing how to parse preview.yaml and call 'apply --confirm' from a gated pipeline." Final reviewers approved after fixes.

CI summary: CI pipeline initially failed on a flaky integration test 'TestDryrunConvergence' (timeout in CI env). Reproduced locally on slow runner, reduced test timeout and added deterministic seeding to the synthetic load generator; re-ran CI -> all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, build). Checks: build: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass (rerun); lint: pass; docs-linkcheck: pass.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main by Priya Nair on 2026-02-21. Follow-ups: ENG-2102 (UX: web-console preview panel), ENG-2115 (policy: auto-apply guardrails + rollout automation), ENG-2150 (pilot telemetry analysis to validate unit-econ estimator).

Operational impact: Low-risk. New presets YAML added to deploy/presets is optional; operators can opt-in tenants. The default behavior is preview-only, so no immediate changes to tenant serving behavior unless 'apply' is invoked.

Notes for release: Ship as part of 2026.02.3 minor release; include short blog post for pilot customers and run a targeted pilot with three tenants to validate estimator accuracy.
